purpose: Current full import and export audit; no implementation changes in this audit.

fixtures.description: Raspberry Pi Beginners Guide fifth edition, 288 pages
User-supplied 43-page A0 drawing from previous audit; private fixture not redistributed

method: Three rounds per fixture and variant, fresh browser each session, sequential alternating variant order. No build or independent validation ran during timing.
Identical production service calls and benchmark entry; input and donor bytes preloaded before the memory baseline.
Save timing covers PDF generation and worker response. File picker, disk write completion and recent-file preview regeneration are outside this timing.
Import includes complete preview hydration and main-owner source registration. Full donor documents are imported.
The common download phase calls output.slice() before Blob creation; application save code does not have this extra copy. Including-download peaks are not exact application save peaks.
PSS is Chromium process-tree proportional resident memory, sampled every 50 ms; shorter peaks can be missed. WASM capacity is not live resident memory.
The host had swap activity; browser SwapPSS is recorded separately. CPU-only Chromium data does not establish Tauri or GPU performance.
One persistent native PDF per owner. Donor import temporarily reaches two, then returns to one. This is not a claim of one document globally at every instant.

identifiedWork.finding: Preview parses in a separate worker; main registration reopens donor and grafts the whole catalog/page set, even when UI selects a subset.
identifiedWork.next: Reuse import parsing in the owner; graft selected pages plus required forms, links and resources, preserving rollback and undo ownership.

identifiedWork.finding: SaveStream collects the entire native output; saveEditingDocument copies it into a full JS array before transfer. Application supports whole-buffer write or Blob fallback.
identifiedWork.next: Add bounded, backpressured output chunks and file sinks; retain a buffer fallback for unsupported platforms.

identifiedWork.finding: Recent-file refresh receives newly exported bytes, so it has no existing byte owner and opens a temporary PDF for a small preview. Web already schedules this work during idle time; save completion does not wait for preview rasterization. It still retains output bytes and consumes background resources.
identifiedWork.next: Generate or reuse a preview of the exact saved editing revision, preserving the existing asynchronous update, without reopening the exported PDF.

identifiedWork.finding: Export cancellation is not propagated into exportPDF/saveEditingDocument; native Create and donor graft are synchronous. Each save reapplies model changes transactionally and rewrites reachable objects.
identifiedWork.next: Propagate AbortSignal, introduce resumable native work, batch dirty-object updates, then assess genuine incremental PDF saving separately.

identifiedWork.finding: PDF.js is absent from application runtime imports. Native parsing/rendering/writing uses PDFium, but pdf-lib object/layout/font/form/appearance helpers remain application dependencies. Standalone @legir/pdfium has no pdf-lib runtime dependency.
identifiedWork.next: Migrate helpers behind engine-owned APIs in stages; remove the pinned compatibility layer only after forms, fonts, annotations, replies and export preservation pass.
